assertions.assertion: States SignOutAsync removes the IdentityServer cookie and the server-side session record but not the external IdP session, client sessions, refresh/reference tokens, or consents by default
assertions.rationale: Claims clients are notified and refresh/reference tokens revoked on logout, contradicting default of not cleaning them.

assertions.assertion: States JWT access tokens are never revoked and expire on their own
assertions.rationale: States JWT access tokens are not revocable and expire.

assertions.assertion: Explains CoordinateLifetimeWithUserSession / Authentication.CoordinateClientLifetimesWithUserSession revokes refresh and reference tokens (client value wins; no server-side sessions required)
assertions.rationale: Mentions coordination setting but not client-wins/no-server-side-sessions-required explanation.

assertions.assertion: States on server-side session expiry, coordinated-lifetime clients always have tokens revoked and get back-channel logout, and other clients only if ServerSideSessions.ExpiredSessionsTriggerBackchannelLogout is true (default false)
assertions.rationale: Does not state coordinated-lifetime clients always get back-channel logout on expiry.
